situation: Cash-starved family foundry: half the shop floor idle, two shifts on short hours, the bank watching monthly. The 66-year-old owner has no successor and is open to selling. Its 2026-09 quotes hold prices flat but ask for payment within 10 days. Prices sit at or below its full cost (310011 +0.2 %, 310012 -3 %), so it 'cannot sign anything that lowers our margin'. Cash timing and volume are the currency, not price cuts.

focusing on customers with volume; we are 6.7 % of its turnover
